entry.name: rnbo_adsr~

arguments.name: attack
arguments.digest: Attack of the ADSR. The duration in ms of the attack portion of the envelope. This is the time it takes for the incoming signal to go from silence to full volume.
arguments.description: Attack of the ADSR. The duration in ms of the attack portion of the envelope. This is the time it takes for the incoming signal to go from silence to full volume.

arguments.name: decay
arguments.description: Decay of the ADSR. The duration in ms of the decay portion of the envelope. How long it takes for the input signal to reach the gain level specified by the sustain attribute.

arguments.name: sustain
arguments.description: The gain (0. - 1.) of the sustain portion of the envelope. This is the gain, or loudness, of the decay that will be maintained after the decay portion of the envelope until the release is triggered.

arguments.name: release
arguments.description: Release of the ADSR. The duration in ms of the release portion of the envelope. This is the time it takes to go from the sustain level to silence.
